ObjectName.value: An Oige Mountain lodge nestled in the Galtee Mountain Range - geograph.org.uk - 1103664

Categories.value: Hostels in Ireland|Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland|Galtee Mountains|Information field template with formatting|Images by Bryan Conlon

ImageDescription.value: An Oige Mountain lodge nestled in the Galtee Mountain Range This building is available for hire to groups through the Irish Youth Hostelling association (www.anoige.ie).  It is the perfect base for access to the famous Galtee Mountain Range in County Tipperary (Highest Peak Galtee Mór at 919m).  The building does not have electricity and is run on gas, even the lighting is gas!  It is a 2.5k trek from the main road and a gorgeous onwards trek to the hills.   The Burncourt river runs along the creen just below the lodge.
